notes.title: 2023/12/19 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Here is the translation of the update content:[/h3]

- Added 7 new endings
- Increased the maximum item capacity
- Added multiple items corresponding to the new endings
- Changed the controls for certain actions
- Modified some elements of the user interface
- Bug fixes


[h3]Addendum[/h3]
About controller support
When a controller is connected to the PC, it automatically enters controller mode.
If you want to use the mouse to select settings, the controller must be unconnected.
(We plan to make it possible to switch from the settings screen in a future update.)

notes.title: Major Update and Achievement Additions
notes.notes:
Achievements are being added to confirm the major update.
Currently, the achievements cannot be unlocked yet, but they will be available after the update is applied.
We plan to release them as soon as we finish checking that they work.

notes.title: Update 2023/03/05
notes.notes:
Bug fixes
Fixed a bug that caused the screen to remain bright when entering and exiting the rooftop
Fixed bug that items can be dropped on the fast travel screen
Fixed T-POSE bug
Fixed the bug that Makina disappears when the valve handle is executed while Makina is hidden in the pool.

Fixed the bug that Makina disappears when the valve handle is executed while Makina is hiding in the pool.
Fixed a bug that when the game is started while the uncle's 3rd chime (super fast ping pong) is sounding in the room, the human body model will not be displayed.
When the game is started with the uncle's third chime (super fast ping pong) ringing in the room, the human body model will be changed.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused the T-Pose to get stuck when contacting a Makina in the T-Pose state

notes.title: 02/21 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Change the speed and attack power of Machina depending on the difficulty level.
[*] Tweaked player stamina
[*] Adjusted class changeover time.
[*] Fixed a problem with append disks turning into different items when picked up again.
[*] Fixed a typo in the mission text.
[*] Fixed a typo in the ending.
[*] The cursor disappears when the E button is pressed in the inventory while fast-traveling.
[*] Fixed freeze when Machina appears from a hidden place.
[*] Changed the color of some NPCs' clothes.
[*] Fixed volume of some sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Notice Concerning Live Game Streaming
notes.notes:
[b]About the game live-streaming[/b].

There are no restrictions regarding the video and live streaming of "Love Love School Days".
There is no problem with monetization (including donations, etc.), so please feel free to distribute your videos.
No prior notice is required.

notes.title: Ending 6 Conditions
notes.notes:
The conditions for ending 6 were too no-hints, so I'll describe the conditions

[olist]
[*] Start the game without skipping the opening.

[*] Go to the scene in your room.

[*] Delete the folder 
[*] [strike]C:\Users\(your user name)\AppData\LocalLow\OTLGAME\LoveLoveSchoolDays\chara[/strike]
[b]%userprofile%\appdata\locallow\OTLGAME\LoveLoveSchoolDays\chara[/b]


[*] Set BrainLink and game disk and start the game.

[*] The flag of the ending 6 is established.
[/olist]

notes.title: Currently found bug information
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been found

The game freezes when Makina comes out from her hiding place.
The boss disappears in the last battle.
The sound effect of traps is too loud.
The sound effect of the trap is too loud.
The screen remains bright.

The black belt appears during the chase and the staff roll is played.
It is not a bug, but a trap event in Makina.

notes.title: February 7, 2023 bug fixes and difficulty adjustment update
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented the selection of items after losing the boss fight in the gym
Increased stamina of the main character
Increased the camera's hit detection
Decreased the speed at which the Machina runs
Decreased the frequency of appearance of the Machina
Increased the time until classes change

notes.title: Bug in gym boss fight.
notes.notes:
We have received a bug report that items become inoperable after fighting and defeating the boss in the gym.
We will update the game as soon as the bug is fixed, so please be patient!
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
